anomalies.observed: Both ground pins on each isolated CAN transceiver are connected to the same GND net: U10.4 (GND1) and U10.5 (GND2), and U11.4 (GND1) and U11.5 (GND2).
anomalies.expected: For the specified isolated CAN interfaces, each transceiver's GND1 and GND2 must remain on separate ground domains; the isolated-side ground must not be tied to the logic-side GND.

evidence.quote: two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller [...] through an isolated CAN transceiver (U11/companion)

anomalies.impact: The CAN buses may still communicate, but the ground connection bypasses the transceivers' galvanic isolation, defeating the specified isolation and its protection against ground-potential differences and common-mode noise.

parsed.summary: An anomaly is present: both isolated CAN transceivers have their logic-side and bus-side grounds tied to the same GND net, bypassing the specified galvanic isolation.
